meta.title: USD curve definitions: the SOFR OIS discount / projection curve on four schemes
meta.description: The calibration instrument set of PROBLEM.md section 4 Stage A: the overnight SOFR fixing, the front SOFR OIS (1M-3M), eight SR3 futures (the front two years, convexity zero and stated) and SOFR OIS from 3Y; knots at the instruments' maturities (the last cash-flow time). The same set is recorded on a linear zero-rate curve (the M1 scheme), on log-DF, on a monotone cubic (Hyman) zero curve and on a composite (linear zero to 3Y, monotone cubic to 15Y, log-linear DF beyond). Tenors from the convention's cited standard tenor set (blueprints/conventions/instruments.json USD-SOFR-OIS.tenors; docs/G4_BUNDLE.md USD.3-USD.5).
sources: docs/G4_BUNDLE.md USD.3 (SOFR OIS tenor set: CFTC MAT 2023-07-07 + the commonly quoted front end), USD.4 (SR3 reference quarters), USD.5 (the overnight fixing as the first instrument)
PROBLEM.md section 3 (interpolation schemes and the composite curve by region) and section 4 Stage A (the SOFR curve recorded on log-DF, monotone cubic and a composite variant)
notes: The 1M-3M OIS bridge the overnight fixing and the first IMM quarter (own construction, a curve-definition matter: the exact front-end set is UNVERIFIED market practice, G4_BUNDLE.md section 4 item 5).

USD-SOFR.description: SOFR OIS curve, linear in the zero rate (the M1 scheme), knots at the instrument maturities.

USD-SOFR-LOGDF.description: The same instrument set on log-linear discount factors (piecewise-constant forwards).

USD-SOFR-MONOTONE.description: The same instrument set on a monotone cubic (Hyman-filtered) zero curve.

USD-SOFR-COMPOSITE.description: The same instrument set on a composite: linear zero to the 3Y knot, monotone cubic zero to 15Y, log-linear DF beyond.
